response.justification: Strongly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB and AWS at Optilyz and RIDE, plus current AI-agent and MCP tooling work at re:cinq that maps precisely to the 'AI agent development' requirement. Deep testing culture (TDD, authored a test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/testing courses) and infrastructure familiarity (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitLab) fit the internal-automation-tooling context well. Gaps are mostly stack-specific rather than fundamental: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin, or recent Java/PostgreSQL evidence, and a notable share of the portfolio is in niche D-lang work. Given the breadth and polyglot track record, these should be quick to verify in a technical interview.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React + MongoDB/AWS full-stack delivery experience
Hands-on AI agent / MCP tooling work, a rare and explicitly required skill
Exceptional testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, authored test tooling, CI/CD)
concerns: No evidence of Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest specifically in the resume
Kotlin absent and Java/relational DB experience appears dated
Significant effort in niche D-lang ecosystem; frontend (React) depth is thinly described
